# Round 5, R4 (docs/gpu-experiments/05-final/02-local-gpu-split.md): the fault of MIN-36, the half merge
# without the GEMV linears (round 4: L27_head_it1_..._rf_w2cktile_mt_mh2, hipErrorIllegalAddress in the
# first launch; with the GEMV linears the same merge runs every final). F5's readings (04-checklist.md)
# found the maps and the event structure, the task types, the store and the memory layout identical to
# the builds that run, and found that no row of the faulting configuration ever ran at 2 layers, so the
# layer count is not known to matter. This file locates the fault at 2 layers (45 s a row): the
# configuration itself, then the graph cut after the first stock o_proj and after the first merge
# (--stop-after: the row's verdict is the run's rc and fault count, no compare), then the halves control.
# queue-h7.txt (the layer bisect) runs only if the first row here passes.
--layers 2 --iters 1 --final --no-gemv-linears compare continue    # R4: the faulting configuration at 2 layers
--layers 2 --iters 1 --final --no-gemv-linears --stop-after L0.o_proj continue    # R4: the graph cut after the first stock o_proj
--layers 2 --iters 1 --final --no-gemv-linears --stop-after L0.mla_merge_uv continue    # R4: the graph cut after the first merge
--layers 2 --iters 1 --final --no-gemv-linears --merge-halves 1 compare continue    # R4: the halves control
